subject: Request: short endorsement for CrossCloud co-sell badge (ZenHealth)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@crosscloud.io>, Ben Simmons <ben.simmons@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Request: short endorsement for CrossCloud co-sell badge (ZenHealth)

Hi Anna and Ben,

Quick ask — CrossCloud has offered to add Redwood to their co-sell badge on the CrossCloud marketplace, which is a nice channel for the ZenHealth deal. To complete the marketplace listing they typically request a 1-2 sentence customer endorsement and permission to display the customer logo.

Attached is a draft quote we can propose for the badge and a one-line suggestion for the endorsement (zenhealth-quote-draft.pdf). Would you be able to: 
- Confirm you’re comfortable with the quote as-is or flag edits (Marissa, I’ve CC’d you)
- Approve a one-sentence endorsement and logo use for CrossCloud public listing

Suggested endorsement (feel free to edit): "Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference latency by 3x and cut inference spend in half — it’s production-ready and reliable."

If it helps, Anna — we can align on wording that meets CrossCloud’s badge guidelines. Ben, a short approval reply is perfect (logo permission + signed-off line). If you need a separate procurement signature, flag here.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. This will unlock additional co-sell enablement and marketplace visibility for ZenHealth + Redwood.

—
Rachel Kim
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@crosscloud.io>

Date: 2026-12-19T10:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short endorsement for CrossCloud co-sell badge (ZenHealth)

Hi Rachel — thanks for the note and congrats to the team. Happy to include ZenHealth on the CrossCloud marketplace. A couple quick items from our side:
- Attached are the CrossCloud badge copy rules and visual requirements (crosscloud_badge_guidelines.docx). We usually ask endorsements to avoid direct dollar/percentage claims — focus on outcomes and experience.
- If ZenHealth prefers the original suggested wording, we can sanitize it to fit our guidelines.

Suggested sanitized line: "Redwood Inference has helped us significantly improve inference latency and reduce costs in production."

Marissa — once you confirm the quote and Ben confirms logo permission I can route this through our content review and publish the listing (2–3 business days).

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Lee
Partner Programs, CrossCloud
anna.lee@crosscloud.io
